title: 2026 UK CBAM relief public-information evidence QA controls

sources.title: What you need to work out Carbon Price Relief
Get a carbon pricing verification form

facts.source_fact: Carbon Price Relief requires a completed verification form and publicly available information.
Public information is used to identify the applicable carbon pricing scheme.
Public information is used to establish headline carbon prices.
Graduated carbon prices require the relevant publicly available scheme information.
The relevant graduated price is averaged over the calendar quarter before import.
Recognised greenhouse-gas-removal prices must be publicly available.
Only payments recognised by a qualifying carbon pricing scheme are in scope for relief.
Compensation details must be publicly available from the jurisdiction or its administering organisations.
Not every carbon-pricing component applies to every scheme.
Public pricing evidence supports a tax calculation and is not a direct emissions measurement.
